ops.title: rm-guard deny paths fail-open after cc-transcript 14.7/rable swap (8 tests)
ops.premise: Unmasked by repairing test_pack_deletions.py collection (broken since b65dfe88). 8 deny-path tests fail on base 4e1ed257 with rable-backed cc-transcript 14.7.0: rm $FOO (variable), rm '*.txt' (quoted glob), rm /outside/{a,b} (braces), quoted-tilde/quoted-backslash/backslash-newline emissions, glob-over-limit — all ALLOWED instead of DENIED. Suspicion (falsifiable): the rable parser's Word/quote-part representation changed what deletions.py's target verification sees — quoted/expansion-bearing operands no longer classify as unverified/has_glob, so the guard fails open instead of closed. Live exposure: every repo running capt-hook@main or the plugin has a fail-open rm guard for these classes. Intersects the in-flight rable wave (memory: 'tainted payloads enumerate span-less; confirm before 14.7.0 release' — 14.7.0 shipped). Repro: uv run pytest tests/test_pack_deletions.py in /private/tmp/capt-hook-docs-wave @ a193b157.
